decisions.reason: Its adjustable cardboard format remains very close to our core display knowledge and can still be improved through in-house development, so despite some overlap risk we would retain it.

As a fairly standard quarter-pallet cardboard display with substantial overlap to other variants, its incremental learning value is now limited and we would reallocate resources to stronger core lines and new development.
The eighth-pallet format extends our established cardboard display range in a way we can readily understand, refine, and commercialize with existing capabilities.

The wooden display pallet remains less aligned with our paper-based production and R&D knowledge, so our absorptive capacity is weaker here and resources are better focused on core cardboard solutions.
This media-oriented cardboard quarter-pallet display still builds on our established customer and product knowledge, which supports continued adaptation rather than withdrawal.
